A novel automatic framework for variational color image segmentation based on unifying adaptive region information and mixture modelling

We propose a novel automatic framework for variational color image segmentation based on unifying adaptive region information and mixture modelling. We consider a formulation of the region information based on the posterior probability of a mixture of general Gaussian pdfs where each region is represented by a pdf. The segmentation is formulated by the minimization of an energy functional according to the region contours and all the mixture parameters respectively. Two main objectives are achieved by the approach. A scheme is provided to extend easily the adaptive segmentation to an arbitrary number of regions and to perform it in a fully automatic fashion.
